what: The accent color paints a faint 1px border clockwise from 12 o’clock in one full turn (conic gradient boundary angle 0 → 360° over .6s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)) — on release it rewinds the same way. The icon inside (data-fx-part=icon) line also turns the accent color in .3s. Corners follow the border-radius of the attached element as is

options.--fx-from: Angle where painting starts, default 0deg (12 o’clock)
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Icon that changes to the accent color along with it (optional) — changes the svg’s stroke

use: View more

from.where: shared.css .vp-sweep (View more pill · recruiting guidelines box · interview card) — original c-button--border::before --border-sweep .6s

note: Angles are grown with @property and transitioned — browsers that don’t know @property paint everything at once on hover
